text:
Noah (People Ops): quick one for folks taking parental leave soon: what do we do about company equipment loans (monitors, standing desks, baby-proofing kits) while an employee is on leave? who pays shipping if something needs to be returned temporarily?
Tara: my partner is working remotely from another state for a month while i transition back and wants to borrow my second monitor. wondered if the company can ship it to them and cover costs.
Noah (People Ops): we generally allow temporary re-loans for short-term family arrangements, but need IT sign-off and a movement log. policy summary:
- Employee must submit Equipment Movement Request in the HR portal.
- IT approves based on asset type and location.
- Shipping for short-term reuse (<= 30 days) is covered by Redwood if pre-approved; otherwise employee covers cost.
- If the equipment is being used by a contractor or non-employee, manager + People Ops approval required.
Luis (IT): practical notes: if a monitor or dock is shipped, IT needs the serial number and the intended user address. include the asset tag in the request. we prefer using our vendor shipping account (faster) but will only authorize after People Ops approval.
Olivia: what about baby-proofing kit (outlet covers, corner guards) we requested last time? are those treated as small office supplies or a temporary loan?
Noah (People Ops): baby-proofing kits are treated as "employee support supplies". small items (< $75 total) can be expensed through the usual process and don't require IT sign-off. if you want us to ship from HQ stock, submit a Movement Request and Logistics Bot will route it.
Logistics Bot: Movement Request form: https://intranet.redwood/equipment/move - Required fields: employee name, asset tag (if applicable), destination address, dates of movement, manager approver. Shipping covered: yes (<= 30 days, pre-approved) / no (otherwise).
Tara: do we need to return things before FMLA paperwork completes or can we delay until the end of leave?
Noah (People Ops): you can keep most personal/provisioned equipment while on leave. exceptions: devices on long-term loan where the asset is reallocated for business-critical coverage. People Ops will notify with 2 weeks' notice and coordinate shipping/temporary replacement.
Luis (IT): also +1 to document condition before shipping (photo of asset tag and screen for monitors). IT will update asset status on receipt.
Olivia: if company ships to a home address, are we comfortable with liability?
Noah (People Ops): shipping terms: Redwood covers transit insurance for company-owned assets when using vendor account. If employee ships on their own and it gets lost, we recommend using tracked shipping and saving receipts; reimbursement may be denied if not pre-approved.
Tara: great, i'll fill the Movement Request now and cc my manager. thanks! :white_check_mark:
